Ben wrote about the day in the diary. Last Tuesday, Ben and Grace went to the community center. The community center is one of the best places in the city. Best of all, the bedroom carpet is soft and thick.
Life is full of small surprises. It takes twenty minutes to get to the community center by bike. There are always many people at the repair shop. Dad keeps an electric shaver in his travel bag.
Both of them like soup and tea. Ben likes sunny days best. Ben thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. What's more, the hotel service is excellent.
Ben is going to travel to London in May. Ben usually has soup for breakfast. The weather was sunny that day.
